purpose: Manufacturer-level guardrails used with robot-specific normal baseline data.
sourceNotes: Operating temperature -20 to 60 C is treated as the recommended normal range.
Maximum temperature register default is treated as 70 C; verify each servo EEPROM for final calibration.
Current feedback unit is approximately 6.5 mA per LSB.
Load feedback is an estimated duty/load percentage, so temperature and current are weighted higher.
Protection Time EEPROM value is not treated as a confirmed dashboard constant; read the actual servo register before presenting it as an official value.

protection.dashboardOverloadSustainNote: Dashboard conservative rule: if high load is sustained for 200 ms, show a check/cooling warning. This is not a confirmed EEPROM default.
